## Check the mutations that appear 5 or more times

### Generate prediction results

```{r}
result_matrix = NULL

pcuts = c(5e-3, 1e-2, 5e-2, 1e-1, 2e-1, 5e-1)

for(f1 in res_files){
  r1 = fread(file.path(res_dir, f1))
  c_type = str_extract(f1, "(?<=_wo_)\\w+")
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("cancer type", c_type, "\n")
  cat(date(), "\n")

  d1 = get_dat_one_cancer(c_type, TCR_data, mut_data, sample_info)
  
  mut1 = d1$mut_mat
  tcr1 = d1$TCR_mat
  
  n_per_mut = rowSums(mut1)
  ww3 = which(n_per_mut >= 3)
  
  if(length(ww3) == 0){
    cat("no mutation appear in 3 or more subjects.\n")
  }else{
    mut_nms = rownames(mut1)[ww3]
    
    cat(sprintf("there are %d mutation appear in 3 or more subjects.\n", 
                length(ww3)))
    
    mut_nms = mut_nms[which(mut_nms %in% r1$mut)]
    
    cat(sprintf("%d mutations are associated with at least one TCR.\n", 
                length(mut_nms)))
    

    for(j in 1:length(mut_nms)){
      mut_j = mut1[rownames(mut1) == mut_nms[j],]
      res_j = r1[which(r1$mut == mut_nms[j]),,drop = FALSE]
      
      for(i in 1:length(pcuts)){
        pcut_i = pcuts[i]
        ww_i = which(res_j$pval_LRT < pcut_i)
        
        if(length(ww_i) == 0){ next }
        
        tcr_ji = res_j$TCR[ww_i]
        ww_tcr = which(rownames(tcr1) %in% tcr_ji)
        if(length(ww_tcr) == 0){ next }
        
        tcr_pred_ji = colSums(tcr1[ww_tcr,,drop=FALSE] > 0)
        
        auc_val = auc(response=mut_j, predictor=tcr_pred_ji, 
                      quiet=TRUE, direction="<")

        auc_ci  = ci.auc(response=mut_j, predictor=tcr_pred_ji, 
                         quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
        auc_ci  = signif(auc_ci, 3)
        
        df1 = data.frame(cancer=c_type, mut=mut_nms[j], auc=signif(auc_val,3), 
                         auc_ci_low=auc_ci[1], auc_ci_med=auc_ci[2], 
                         auc_ci_upper=auc_ci[3], pcut = pcut_i)
        result_matrix = rbind(result_matrix, df1)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Summerize prediction results

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
dim(result_matrix)
result_matrix = result_matrix[order(result_matrix$auc, decreasing = TRUE),]
flextable(result_matrix[1:5,])

result_matrix[result_matrix$mut == "PIK3CA:3:178936091:G:A",]


table(result_matrix$pcut)
summary(result_matrix$auc)

summary(result_matrix$auc[result_matrix$pcut==0.02])
summary(result_matrix$auc[result_matrix$pcut==0.1])
summary(result_matrix$auc[result_matrix$pcut==0.2])
summary(result_matrix$auc[result_matrix$pcut==0.5])

pcuts = unique(result_matrix$pcut)
pcuts = sort(pcuts[pcuts > 0.0009])
min_auc_4_pcuts = rep(NA, length(pcuts))

auc_cutoffs = seq(0.51, 0.7, by=0.001)

for(k in 1:length(pcuts)){
  
  pcut1 = pcuts[k]
  
  g1 = ggplot(result_matrix[result_matrix$pcut==pcut1,], aes(x=auc)) +
  geom_histogram(color="darkblue", fill="lightblue", 
                 breaks=seq(0.29, 0.87, by=0.02)) + scale_y_log10() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.5), linetype = "dashed") + 
    ggtitle(sprintf("pval-cutoff = %.1e", pcut1)) + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) + xlab("AUC") + ylab("Count")
  
  auc_vals = result_matrix$auc[result_matrix$pcut==pcut1]
  fdrs = rep(NA, length(auc_cutoffs))
  
  for(i in 1:length(auc_cutoffs)){
    auc1 = auc_cutoffs[i]
    nD = sum(auc_vals > auc1)
    if(nD == 0){ fdrs[i] = 0 }
    else{ fdrs[i] = min(1, sum(auc_vals < 1-auc1)/nD) }
  }
  
  for(i in length(auc_cutoffs):2){
    if(fdrs[i-1] < fdrs[i]){
      fdrs[i-1] = fdrs[i]
    }
  }
  
  df1 = data.frame(auc = auc_cutoffs, fdr = fdrs)
  
  min_auc_4_pcuts[k] = min(auc_cutoffs[fdrs < 0.2])

  g2 = ggplot(df1, aes(x = auc, y = fdr)) + 
    geom_line() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = min_auc_4_pcuts[k], linetype = "dashed") + 
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", min_auc_4_pcuts[k])), 
              x = min_auc_4_pcuts[k], y = 1.0, hjust = -0.2) + 
    ylim(0, 1) + xlim(0.5, 0.75)  + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) + xlab("AUC") + ylab("FDR")

  gg1 = ggarrange(g1, g2, ncol = 2, nrow = 1)
  
  print(gg1)

}

df2 = data.frame(pcuts = pcuts, min_auc_4_fdr = min_auc_4_pcuts)
ggplot(df2, aes(x = -log10(pcuts), y = min_auc_4_fdr)) + 
  geom_point() + ylab("min AUC for FDR < 0.2") + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)

w2kp = NULL
for(k in 1:length(pcuts)){
  pcut1 = pcuts[k]
  auck = min_auc_4_pcuts[k]
  w2kp = c(w2kp, which(result_matrix$pcut == pcut1 & result_matrix$auc > auck))
}
length(w2kp)

result_sub = result_matrix[w2kp, 
                           c("cancer", "auc", "auc_ci_low", "pcut", "mut")]

result_sub$mut_30 = substring(result_sub$mut, 1, 30)

dim(result_sub)
flextable(result_sub[1:2,])
flextable(result_sub[1:min(20, nrow(result_sub)),c(1:4,6)])

table(result_matrix$pcut)
table(result_sub$pcut)
```

## Classify multiple mutations together. 

Since many somatic mutations are rare and thus we cannot evaluate the classification accuracy reliably. Here we try to concatenate the mutation data of multiple mutations and try to predict them. We select the mutations with certain frequencies. ```n_mut_lower``` and  ```n_mut_upper``` are lower and upper bound of mutation frequnceis. 

```{r}

get_auc <- function(res_files, pcuts, TCR_data, mut_data, sample_info,
                    n_mut_lower, n_mut_upper){
  
  if(n_mut_lower < 1){ stop("n_mut_lower should 1 or larger") }
  stopifnot(n_mut_upper > n_mut_lower)
  
  result_aggre = NULL

  for(f1 in res_files){
    r1 = fread(file.path(res_dir, f1))
    c_type = str_extract(f1, "(?<=_wo_)\\w+")
    
    cat("\n")
    cat("cancer type", c_type, "\n")
    cat(date(), "\n")
  
    d1 = get_dat_one_cancer(c_type, TCR_data, mut_data, sample_info)
    
    mut1 = d1$mut_mat
    tcr1 = d1$TCR_mat
    
    n_per_mut = rowSums(mut1)
    ww_aggr = which(n_per_mut >= n_mut_lower & n_per_mut <= n_mut_upper)
    
    if(length(ww_aggr) == 0){
      cat("no mutation can be aggregated\n")
    }else{
      mut_nms = rownames(mut1)[ww_aggr]
      
      cat(sprintf("%d mutation (%d <= freq <= %d) to be aggregated\n", 
                  length(ww_aggr), n_mut_lower, n_mut_upper))
      
      mut_nms = mut_nms[which(mut_nms %in% r1$mut)]
      
      cat(sprintf("%d mutations are associated with at least one TCR.\n", 
                  length(mut_nms)))
      
      if(length(mut_nms) == 0){ 
        next 
      }
      
      mut_mtrx = mut1[rownames(mut1) %in% mut_nms,,drop=FALSE]
      dim(mut_mtrx)
      
      for(i in 1:length(pcuts)){
        pcut_i = pcuts[i]
        
        y_i = NULL
        x_i = NULL
        n_mut = 0
        
        for(j in 1:length(mut_nms)){
          mut_j = as.numeric(mut_mtrx[which(rownames(mut_mtrx) == mut_nms[j]),])
          res_j = r1[which(r1$mut == mut_nms[j]),,drop = FALSE]
        
          ww_i = which(res_j$pval_LRT < pcut_i)
          
          if(length(ww_i) == 0){ next }
          
          tcr_ji = res_j$TCR[ww_i]
          ww_tcr = which(rownames(tcr1) %in% tcr_ji)
          if(length(ww_tcr) == 0){ next }
          
          tcr_pred_ji = colSums(tcr1[ww_tcr,,drop=FALSE] > 0)
          
          y_i = c(y_i, mut_j)
          x_i = c(x_i, tcr_pred_ji)
          n_mut = n_mut + 1
        }
        
        # cat("pcut", pcut_i, "\n")
        # cat("combining the data of", n_mut, "mutations\n")
        
        if(n_mut > 0){
          auc_ci  = ci.auc(response=y_i, predictor=x_i, 
                               quiet=TRUE, direction="<")
              
          df1 = data.frame(cancer=c_type, pcut = pcut_i, auc=auc_ci[2], 
                               auc_ci_low=auc_ci[1], auc_ci_upper=auc_ci[3])
          result_aggre = rbind(result_aggre, df1)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  result_aggre
}

```

## Aggregate rare mutations

```{r}
pcuts = c(1e-4, 2e-4, 5e-4, 1e-3, 2e-3, 5e-3, 1e-2, 2e-2, 5e-2, 1e-1*(1:5))

n_mut_lower = 1
n_mut_upper = 4

res_agg1 = get_auc(res_files, pcuts, TCR_data, mut_data, sample_info,
                    n_mut_lower, n_mut_upper)

dim(res_agg1)
res_agg1 = res_agg1[order(res_agg1$auc, decreasing = TRUE),]
res_agg1[1:5,]
summary(res_agg1$auc)
res_agg1[which(res_agg1$auc > 0.52),]

n_mut_lower = 5
n_mut_upper = 10

res_agg2[1:5,]

res_agg2[which(res_agg2$auc > 0.55),]
```
